name: @streamarr-tv/app-vidaa-fallback
description: Minimal PWA shell for VIDAA (Hisense) TVs, bootstrapping @streamarr-tv/ui-tv + @streamarr-tv/player-shaka. Per the plan, VIDAA has no dedicated native SDK target yet -- this fallback runs as an installable PWA against VIDAA's browser, gated behind the vidaaOtaEnabled feature flag.
